cases.request: Write a cold email to the 40 fintech CTOs on our Q4 list.
cases.reason: First touch to people with no prior engagement is the cold cycle.

cases.request: Sarah from Brightwell just replied asking what the pilot would cost. Draft my answer.
cases.reason: An answer inside a live thread the prospect started is a reply, not new outreach.

cases.request: Build me a list of 200 Series A SaaS companies in Germany we could sell to.
cases.reason: A sourced account list for a segment is the TAM map, phrased without the term.

cases.request: Who should we pitch for our seed round?
cases.reason: Investors are ranked by the fundraise list, not the customer TAM map.

cases.request: How many months of runway do we have left?
cases.reason: Cash, burn and months-left questions are the runway skill, not the budget.

cases.request: Our first engineer starts on Monday and will work from Lisbon. What do we need to have done before then?
cases.reason: A new hire's contract, payroll, access and local obligations are the joiner lifecycle.

cases.request: Set up an agent that reviews our sales pipeline every Monday morning.
cases.reason: Creating and scheduling a company agent is agent management; loading the pipeline pass it will run is also a defensible route.

cases.request: Prep me for my call with Acme tomorrow at 10.
cases.reason: Preparing a named sales call.

cases.request: Follow up with everyone who didn't answer last week's cold email.
cases.reason: A follow-up to an unanswered cold email belongs to the follow-up method, not a new cold cycle.

cases.request: Write a LinkedIn post announcing our launch.
cases.reason: A public post is content; a LinkedIn message is one-to-one outreach.

cases.request: Draft a LinkedIn message to the head of operations at Meridian Fleet, who we met at the logistics expo last week.
cases.reason: A one-to-one note to a named person on LinkedIn.

cases.request: Get our federal corporate income tax return for last year ready for the accountant.
cases.reason: Preparing an income tax return is the entity tax cycle.

cases.request: What does our Delaware C-corp have to file with the state in the next few months?
cases.reason: Corporate filings and their due dates are the compliance register; the franchise tax is listed there and handed to the tax cycle.

cases.request: Is our Companies House confirmation statement due yet?
cases.reason: A registry filing, not a tax return.

cases.request: Our HubSpot contract renews in two weeks. Should we keep it?
cases.reason: Renewal and purchase decisions share one vendor-spend skill.

cases.request: Is it worth buying Gong seats for the two of us who do sales?
cases.reason: Renewal and purchase decisions share one vendor-spend skill.

cases.request: Compare Clay and Apollo as the enrichment source we connect our CRM to, and pick one.
cases.reason: Choosing which connector to integrate is the integration vendor choice; spend review follows only if it costs money.

cases.request: Dana is leaving at the end of the month. What has to happen before and after her last day?
cases.reason: A leaver's access, final pay and handover is the people lifecycle, not the company filing register.

cases.request: Should we move from SMB customers to mid-market next quarter?
cases.reason: A strategic segment shift: executive review or offer and segments are both acceptable; the routing simulation found it ambiguous.

cases.request: Who are our main competitors and how do they price?
cases.reason: Competitive research for the company's market.

cases.request: Fix the failing Jest test in my React app; it says expected 3 received 2 in cart.test.js.
cases.reason: General coding with no company records; Cady must not fire.

cases.request: Write a short email to my sister wishing her a happy birthday.
cases.reason: A personal email is not company outreach.

cases.request: Explain the difference between a Python list and a tuple.
cases.reason: General knowledge question.

cases.request: Write a cold email I can send to hiring managers for my own job search.
cases.reason: Looks like cold outreach but is personal, with no company in Cady; the cold cycle must not fire.

cases.request: Put together next quarter's budget for hiring and marketing.
cases.reason: Allocating spend for a period is the budget review; runway is an input it reads.

cases.request: We have about seven months of cash and no term sheet. What should we cut first?
cases.reason: Cut triggers and cut order belong to the runway skill.

cases.request: At our current growth, do we get to break-even before the money runs out?
cases.reason: Default alive or dead, phrased without the term.

cases.request: Should we raise on a SAFE or do a priced seed round, and how much should we take?
cases.reason: Amount and instrument are the raise plan; who to pitch is the investor list.

cases.request: If we raise 2 million at an 8 million pre with a 10% option pool, how much do the founders own afterwards?
cases.reason: Dilution and option pool maths sit in the raise plan.

cases.request: Draft this month's update for our investors.
cases.reason: The monthly investor update is a raise material, drafted and held unsent.

cases.request: Close the books for September and list what the bookkeeper needs to fix.
cases.reason: A month-end close and its exceptions, not a tax return.

cases.request: Our Stripe payouts don't match the revenue in Xero for last month. Sort out the month-end.
cases.reason: Processor payout reconciliation is part of the period close.

cases.request: Three people answered Tuesday's cold email: one asked about price, one said to talk to their CFO, and one said take me off your list. Handle them.
cases.reason: Answers inside threads the prospects replied to are reply triage, not a new cold cycle or a follow-up.

cases.request: The ops director at Kestrel Freight replied that they already built something in-house for this. How should I respond?
cases.reason: An objection in a live thread is handled by the reply skill.

cases.request: Our cold emails started bouncing at 6% and Gmail is putting the rest in spam. What do we do before the next batch?
cases.reason: Bounce and spam thresholds and the pause they trigger belong to the cold email cycle.

cases.request: LinkedIn just showed me a weekly invitation limit warning halfway through the connection requests. Carry on with the rest of the list.
cases.reason: A LinkedIn limit notice is the stop rule in the LinkedIn message skill.

cases.request: Northwind asked for a proposal after yesterday's discovery call. What goes in it, and how do we get from here to a signature?
cases.reason: Proposal and close plan for one opportunity is the deal motion.

cases.request: Is the Fernhill opportunity real? Their ops lead loved the demo but nobody has mentioned budget or who signs.
cases.reason: Qualifying one opportunity, phrased without sales terms.

cases.request: Go through every customer track that is due this week and set the next action on each.
cases.reason: A pass over many due tracks is the pipeline pass, not one deal worked in depth.

cases.request: Brightline's annual subscription with us renews in 60 days and their usage dropped last month. What should we do?
cases.reason: A customer's renewal of our product is customer success, not a review of our own vendor spend.

cases.request: We just signed Orbit Labs. Plan their first 30 days so they get real value quickly.
cases.reason: Onboarding a signed customer to first value is the customer lifecycle.

cases.request: A customer emailed that they want to cancel at the end of the month. How do we handle it?
cases.reason: Cancellation with one respectful save attempt belongs to the customer lifecycle; the reply copy is a later step.

cases.request: test_invoice_totals fails about one run in ten on CI but always passes on my laptop. What do we do with it?
cases.reason: An intermittent test on unchanged code needs flaky classification (race, shared state or infrastructure) before anyone debugs product code.

cases.request: Since this morning's deploy the orders page returns a 500 for every user. Find out why and fix it.
cases.reason: A reproducible production failure with users affected is incident response and root-cause work, not report triage.

cases.request: A customer says the CSV export is missing rows. Write it up properly and tell me how bad it is.
cases.reason: Rating severity and writing a reproducible report is triage, phrased without the word.

cases.request: Review this pull request before we merge it; it changes how API keys are checked.
cases.reason: An independent review of a diff touching authority, with a verdict, is the review skill.

cases.request: Check our signup flow against WCAG 2.2 AA before launch.
cases.reason: A conformance pass with keyboard, screen reader and contrast checks is the accessibility audit, not visual design critique.

cases.request: Can a keyboard-only user or someone on a screen reader finish our checkout? Test it properly.
cases.reason: Assistive-technology journey testing is the accessibility audit, phrased without the WCAG term.

cases.request: Checkout is down for customers. Run the incident and write the postmortem.
cases.reason: A live outage and its blameless review are the incident part of debugging, phrased without the word debug.

cases.request: Our new landing page feels cluttered. Give me a design critique and a cleaner direction.
cases.reason: Visual direction and hierarchy belong to the design method; an accessibility audit would be the wrong skill.

cases.request: I have five calls with operations managers next week. Help me prepare questions that don't lead them.
cases.reason: Running and scripting interviews is interview craft; the question already exists.

cases.request: Before we commit to the enterprise tier, what do we need to find out and what is the cheapest way to learn it?
cases.reason: Framing the questions a decision needs and choosing the research route comes before any interview.
